text: N088323January 14, 2010CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:WA 356 CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6110.20.2069 Team Creation (HK) LTDUnit 113A , First floor, Mirror Tower61 Mody RoadTST East, KowloonHong KongRE:	The tariff classification of a men’s knit pullover garment from China.Dear Sirs:In your letter, which was received by this office on December 17, 2009, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  As requested, your samples will be returned.Two samples of Product Item No. 20049, “Blinking Eyes T-Shirt,” were submitted, one in black and one in white.  The samples are men’s short sleeve pullover garments constructed from 100% cotton, finely knit jersey fabric that measures 26 stitches per two centimeters counted in the horizontal direction.  The garments are cut and sewn and have a rib knit crew neckline; short, hemmed sleeves; and a straight, hemmed bottom.  There is a large heat seal design on the center chest showing a “Monster Face” with blinking red and green light-up eyes.  A pocket on the inside of the front panel houses the battery pack and wires that operate the LEDs that light up the eyes.  The garments are sold with a descriptive header card that has a “Try Me” button and wire attached to the battery pack to demonstrate the blinking eyes.Product Item No. 20049 is a composite good having the essential character imparted by the garment.  The item is not considered an article of fancy dress and is classified as ordinary wearing apparel.  Consequently, the applicable subheading for Product Item No. 20049 “Blinking Eyes T-Shirt” will be 6110.20.2069, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, (HTSUS), which provides for: sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: of cotton: other: other: other: other: men's or boys'.  The duty rate is 16.5% ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on World Wide Web at http://www.usitc.gov/tata/hts/.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Mary Ryan at 646-733-3271.Sincerely,Robert B. SwierupskiDirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
